# cell          n  wins  win%   median      p
# Identical box (jason), data, seeds, budget (25k steps), online fp32 teacher
# supplying BOTH arms' output target — the arms differ by exactly one loss term.
# Weight derived from a probe (base 0.0091 / aff 0.1092 -> ~25% share), not
# guessed; measured aff_share held 0.18-0.22 through training.
# VERDICT vs the rule fixed BEFORE the data existed (ROADMAP 1.4): PASS.
# Positive per-file median, win_frac > 0.5, low q clearly positive.
#  - The effect is CONCENTRATED at low q and is null-to-slightly-negative from
#    q75 up (no cell there reaches significance in either direction).
#  - Magnitudes are ~0.1 ssim2, an order of magnitude below the 0.3 ceiling for
#    a single comparison. What is established is the systematic DIRECTION, not
#    a difference a viewer would see on one image.
#  - Both arms sit at 25k steps, far from the shipped model's 200k (arm A is
#    -0.354 median against rt24g). This says affinity KD helps at a 25k budget;
